mapper.select: select distinct update_by from ins_car_scene where update_by is not null and update_by != ''

with recursive category_tree as ( select id, patent_id from ins_car_scene_category where id = #{categoryId} union all select c.id, c.patent_id from ins_car_scene_category c inner join category_tree ct on c.patent_id = ct.id where c.id != c.patent_id ) select id from category_tree
